_comment: SPY V17-PRO live trading config. Edit the capital field to match what you intend to deploy. The CLI --capital flag overrides this if provided.
_fractional_shares_help: Set to true if your broker supports fractional shares (e.g. Fidelity, Robinhood, IBKR). When false (default), the position-sizing output rounds DOWN to whole shares and shows leftover cash.
_show_position_sizing_help: Set to false to suppress the POSITION SIZING block in the console output (e.g. for automated scripts that only consume latest_signal.json).
_capital_injections_help: Each entry needs a 'date' (YYYY-MM-DD) and 'amount'. Example: [{"date": "2026-06-01", "amount": 2000}]
